title: XRPL rippled 3.1.3 reproduced P0-class evidence manifest

proof.result: OpenP0Repro: 47 cases, 9119 tests, 0 failures; OpenP0ReproCrash: 1 case, 12 tests, 0 failures

records.title: Lending regular-freeze receive bypass
markers: F3.3 LoanBrokerCoverWithdraw — regular-freeze-only destination (P0)
F3.5 LoanBrokerDelete — regular-freeze-only owner receives cover
F3.6 LoanPay — regular-freeze-only broker owner receives service fee
F3.7 LoanSet — regular-freeze-only broker owner receives origination fee
F3.8 LoanPay — regular-freeze-only vault pseudo receives repayment
F3.9 LoanBrokerCoverDeposit — regular-freeze-only broker pseudo receives cover
F3.10 LoanPay — regular-freeze-only broker pseudo receives fallback fee
records.broken: Several lending paths use the deep-freeze-only predicate on IOU receivers. An issuer regular-freezes a receiver, but the lending transaction still delivers IOU because the path only blocks deep freeze.
records.expected: Any path that delivers issuer IOU to an account must enforce regular freeze with the full frozen check.
records.source_signal: Existing AGTI proof kit plus source review of lending receive checks introduced around PR #5270; VaultWithdraw provides the stricter receiver pattern.
records.remediation: Replace or supplement receiver-side checkDeepFrozen/isDeepFrozen uses with checkFrozen/isFrozen across F3.3 and F3.5-F3.10, then flip the repro expectations from tesSUCCESS to tecFROZEN.

records.title: PermissionedDomainSet ticket sequence collision
markers: PermissionedDomainSet pre-fix ticket sequence collision candidate
records.broken: Ticket-paid PermissionedDomainSet read raw sfSequence, so two ticket-paid creates from the same account collide on keylet::permissionedDomain(account, 0).
records.expected: Ticket-paid creates must use the effective ticket sequence for object identity.
records.source_signal: fixCleanup3_1_3 release history and upstream permissioned-domain patch set.
records.remediation: Use getSeqValue/effective ticket sequence for permissioned-domain creation keys.

records.title: MPT multi-send aggregate MaximumAmount bypass
markers: MPT multi-send pre-fix aggregate MaximumAmount bypass
records.broken: The pre-fix helper allows aggregate sends of 100+100 against MaximumAmount=150, recording outstanding amount beyond the cap.
records.expected: Aggregate multi-send output must be capped by MaximumAmount.
records.remediation: Enforce aggregate MaximumAmount before recording MPT multi-send output.

records.title: VaultWithdraw share-denominated trustline-limit bypass
markers: VaultWithdraw pre-fix share-denominated trustline limit bypass
records.broken: Asset-denominated withdraw respects destination trustline limits, but the equivalent share-denominated withdraw succeeds and increases a low-limit destination balance.
records.expected: Share-denominated and asset-denominated withdraw paths must enforce the same destination trustline limits.
records.remediation: Apply destination trustline-limit checks to share-denominated VaultWithdraw.

records.title: Vault share MPToken deleted while shares remain escrow locked
markers: VaultWithdraw pre-fix deletes share MPToken with locked escrow
records.broken: A withdraw can delete a vault share MPToken even though sfLockedAmount remains nonzero because escrowed shares are ignored by the empty-holding removal path.
records.expected: Any nonzero locked share amount must preserve the MPToken state.
records.remediation: Treat sfLockedAmount as live token state when deciding whether an MPToken can be removed.

records.title: VaultClawback zero-amount unclamped asset clawback
markers: VaultClawback pre-fix zero-amount asset clawback is not clamped to assets available
records.broken: With outstanding loans, zero-amount clawback tries to claw back full share value rather than assetsAvailable and reaches a negative-vault-balance guard.
records.expected: Zero-amount clawback must clamp to available assets.
records.remediation: Clamp zero-amount VaultClawback to sfAssetsAvailable before applying balance changes.

records.title: LoanPay high-amount payment fee uncapped
markers: LoanPay pre-fix high-amount payment requires uncapped fee
records.broken: Fee estimation scales beyond the maximum payment count that the handler can actually process, rejecting a transaction with telINSUF_FEE_P.
records.expected: Fee must be capped consistently with the handler payment cap.
records.remediation: Calculate LoanPay fee using the capped number of processed payments.

records.title: Invariant bool overwrite hides earlier bad entries
markers: Invariant pre-fix — later good entries hide earlier bad entries
records.broken: Some invariant checks use assignment instead of accumulation, so a later valid entry can clear an earlier bad XRP trustline, deep-freeze trustline, or MPT issuance observation.
records.expected: Invariant violation state must accumulate across all inspected entries.
records.remediation: Use accumulating boolean logic for invariant violations and preserve any earlier bad observation.

records.title: Expired credential cleanup ignores delete failure
markers: Credentials pre-fix — expired cleanup ignores deleteSLE failure
records.broken: Credential consumers can report expired/success while expired credential deletion failed and the credential remains in state.
records.expected: Failed expired-credential deletion must fail closed to the consumer.
records.remediation: Propagate deleteSLE failure from expired credential cleanup and stop dependent transaction processing.

records.title: Permissioned-DEX empty AdditionalBooks invariant bypass
markers: Permissioned DEX pre-fix — empty AdditionalBooks hides malformed hybrid offer
records.broken: The pre-fix invariant rejects missing or more-than-one sfAdditionalBooks but lets an empty array pass for a malformed hybrid offer.
records.expected: Hybrid offers must have exactly one valid additional book entry.
records.remediation: Reject empty sfAdditionalBooks arrays in permissioned-DEX hybrid-offer invariant checks.

records.title: LoanBrokerCover IOU precision drift
markers: LoanBrokerCover current — IOU precision drift
records.broken: A deposit of 1.8e-14 credits cover by 2e-14, and positive zero-at-scale deposit/withdraw/clawback amounts can succeed without changing cover or receiver balance.
records.expected: Positive cover operations below effective precision should be rejected or rounded consistently before state mutation.
records.source_signal: Later upstream commits 7fdaa0a5e / PR #7274 and c327fc1ee.
records.remediation: Apply cover-scale minimum checks and reject zero-at-scale cover operations.

records.title: LoanPay minimum-cover scale inconsistency
markers: LoanPay current — broker minimum cover scale inconsistency
records.broken: The same broker-level cover state routes service fees differently depending on an individual loan scale.
records.expected: Broker-cover minimum checks should use vault scale consistently.
records.remediation: Use vault scale for all broker-cover minimum calculations.

records.title: Vault-share MPT transfer restriction bypass
markers: Vault share MPT current — underlying CanTransfer is not inherited
records.broken: After the underlying MPT issuer clears CanTransfer, peer-to-peer vault-share payment still succeeds.
records.expected: Vault-share MPTs should inherit underlying MPT transfer restrictions where the product model requires it.
records.remediation: Propagate underlying MPT flags/reference metadata to vault-share issuances and enforce them on transfer.

records.title: LoanBrokerDelete returns locked MPT first-loss cover
markers: LoanBrokerDelete current — locked MPT cover is returned
records.broken: Deleting a broker returns locked MPT first-loss cover and deletes the locked pseudo-account MPToken.
records.expected: Locked cover should prevent broker deletion or remain locked until safely returnable.
records.remediation: Block LoanBrokerDelete when locked MPT cover cannot be returned safely.

records.title: Loan payment-factor cancellation
markers: Loan current — near-zero payment factor cancellation
records.broken: Near-zero-rate computePaymentFactor diverges from an independent polynomial reference by more than 1e-12.
records.expected: Near-zero-rate formulas should use stable power-minus-one style arithmetic.
records.remediation: Replace direct (1+r)^n - 1 with a numerically stable power-minus-one calculation.

records.title: VaultWithdraw IOU scale-boundary invariant failure
markers: Vault current — withdraw across IOU scale boundary invariant
records.broken: Withdrawing across an IOU scale boundary returns tecINVARIANT_FAILED through vault and destination balance invariant failures.
records.expected: Precision-boundary withdraws should either execute with valid accounting or fail pre-apply with a targeted precision error.
records.remediation: Add proactive precision-boundary rejection before invariant failure.

records.title: VaultDeposit issuer IOU edge invariant failure
markers: Vault current — issuer deposit at IOU edge invariant
records.broken: Issuer deposit at a vault IOU edge returns tecINVARIANT_FAILED instead of a precise rejection.
records.expected: Precision-loss deposits should fail before mutation/invariant handling.
records.remediation: Detect issuer-IOU precision edge before applying vault deposit.

records.title: Sole shareholder impaired vault exit failure
markers: Vault current — sole shareholder impaired exit is stuck
records.broken: After another shareholder exits an impaired vault, the sole remaining shareholder cannot withdraw available cash and hits the zero-sized-vault invariant.
records.expected: A sole remaining shareholder should be able to withdraw available cash while impaired receivables remain represented correctly.
records.remediation: Handle sole-shareholder impaired vault exits without producing zero-sized-vault invariant failure.

records.title: VaultDeposit opposite-limit internal failure
markers: VaultDeposit current — opposite trustline limit causes tefINTERNAL
records.broken: Preclaim counts the counterparty opposite trustline limit, admits the deposit, then apply returns tefINTERNAL after negative account-assets guard.
records.expected: Preclaim and apply must use the same balance/limit model, or fail early with a non-internal code.
records.remediation: Remove the opposite-limit sanity path or align preclaim with actual IOU send semantics.

records.title: EscrowCancel deleted IOU trustline exception
markers: EscrowCancel current — deleted IOU trustline returns tefEXCEPTION
records.broken: Canceling an IOU escrow after the sender trustline was deleted returns tefEXCEPTION / OwnerCount template-field error.
records.expected: Escrow cancellation accounting should not depend on a deleted sender trustline.
records.remediation: Switch token escrow cancellation accounting to the account ledger entry rather than the deleted trustline.

records.title: AMM stale AuthAccounts after empty reinit
markers: AMM current — stale AuthAccounts survive empty reinit
records.broken: Empty-pool reinitialization with tfTwoAssetIfEmpty leaves stale sfAuthAccounts from the prior auction slot.
records.expected: Reinitializing an empty AMM should clear stale auction authorization state.
records.remediation: Clear AuthAccounts during empty-pool AMM reinitialization.

records.title: Delegatee account deletion leaves stale delegation
markers: Delegate current — delegatee account deletion leaves stale delegation
records.broken: A delegatee account can delete itself while the Delegate ledger entry and delegator owner reserve remain behind.
records.expected: Deleting an account must clean or prevent inbound delegated-authority state.
records.remediation: Store Delegate objects in both delegator and authorized-account owner directories or otherwise block deletion with live delegation state.

records.title: Domain-bound MPT RequireAuth clearing
markers: MPT current — domain-bound RequireAuth can be cleared
records.broken: An issuer can clear RequireAuth while retaining DomainID, leaving a domain-bound issuance permissionless in authorization state.
records.expected: Domain-bound issuances should not clear RequireAuth while DomainID remains.
records.remediation: Disallow MPTClearRequireAuth when DomainID is set.

records.title: Number upward-rounding cusp violation
markers: Number current — upward rounding falls below exact at maxRep cusp
records.broken: Under upward rounding, a large Number product stores below the exact product at the maxRep cusp.
records.expected: Directed upward rounding should never store below the exact positive result.
records.remediation: Correct Number rounding at the maxRep cusp and add regression coverage.

records.title: Number upward-division rounding violation
markers: Number current - upward division falls below exact quotient
records.broken: Under upward rounding, 2 / 1,000,000,000,000,000,007 stores below the exact quotient.
records.expected: Directed upward division should not round below exact for positive quotients.
records.remediation: Expand division correction precision and add the quoted quotient regression.

records.title: MPT transfer-rate scaling overflow
markers: MPT current — transfer-rate scaling overflows large integral amount
records.broken: Applying a 1.5 transfer rate to a large integral MPT amount throws overflow_error in the legacy scaled-mantissa path.
records.expected: Valid integral-token amounts should scale through bounded consensus arithmetic or fail cleanly before overflow.
records.remediation: Route MPT/V2 transfer-rate math through Number arithmetic.

records.title: Delegated payment fee coupled to delegator reserve
markers: Delegate current — delegated fee is coupled to delegator reserve
records.broken: A delegated payment returns tecUNFUNDED_PAYMENT even though the delegate can pay the fee, because the path couples the delegate-paid fee to the delegator reserve.
records.expected: Delegate-paid fees should be checked against the delegate fee payer, not the delegator reserve.
records.remediation: Decouple delegate fee payer balance checks from delegator reserve calculations.

records.title: Single Asset Vault transaction can be delegated
markers: Delegate current — SAV transaction can be delegated
records.broken: A delegate can submit VaultCreate for another account; later upstream removed SAV/lending from the delegable transaction set.
records.expected: High-risk SAV/lending operations should be non-delegable unless explicitly sandboxed.
records.remediation: Mark Single Asset Vault and Lending transactions NotDelegable.

records.title: Delegated multisign self-check rejection
markers: Delegate current — delegator multisign rejected for delegate
records.broken: A delegated payment signed by the delegator as part of the delegatee signer list is rejected before ledger application because the path checks the delegator as self-signing.
records.expected: Delegated multisign validation should check the delegate account as acting authority.
records.remediation: Validate delegated multisigning against the delegate account, not the delegator.

records.title: Non-canonical MPT amount reaches ledger engine
records.exploit_type: Malformed amount accepted into application path
markers: MPT current — non-canonical amount reaches ledger engine
records.broken: A non-canonical MPT amount reaches transaction application and returns fee-burning tecPATH_PARTIAL instead of failing preflight as temBAD_AMOUNT.
records.expected: Non-canonical MPT amounts should fail before ledger application.
records.remediation: Reject non-canonical MPT amounts during preflight/preclaim before fee-burning application.

records.title: MPT STIssue legacy wire-order defect
markers: MPT current — STIssue sequence bytes are legacy-swapped
records.broken: Canonical MPTID sequence bytes de ad be ef serialize as ef be ad de; internal round-trip hides the defect while canonical raw payload parses to a different MPTID.
records.expected: Protocol wire serialization should preserve canonical raw MPTID byte order.
records.remediation: Use amended V2 STIssue wire format and canonical raw sequence handling.

records.title: Delegated MPT issuance metadata/fee mutation
markers: Delegate current — MPT granular lock permission mutates issuance fields
records.broken: A delegate with only MPTokenIssuanceLock authority can submit MPTokenIssuanceSet with sfMPTokenMetadata and sfTransferFee, mutating issuance fields outside the delegated permission.
records.expected: Granular delegation must sandbox all fields and flags, not just lock/unlock flags.
records.remediation: Add a granular field/flag sandbox for delegated MPTokenIssuanceSet.

records.title: Delegated empty AccountSet consumes principal sequence
markers: Delegate current — empty AccountSet with unrelated permission consumes principal sequence
records.broken: A delegate with only unrelated Payment authority can submit an empty AccountSet for the principal; it succeeds, advances the principal sequence, and charges the delegate fee.
records.expected: A delegated transaction must require permission for its transaction type even if it has no mutation fields.
records.source_signal: OpenRouter authorization triage plus source review of SetAccount::checkPermission.
records.remediation: Make no-field/no-flag AccountSet require AccountSet delegation authority or reject it as unauthorized under delegation.

records.title: Batch signer outer-account replay
markers: Batch current — batch signer signatures replay across outer account
records.broken: Captured BatchSigners signatures from one valid batch can be replayed under a different outer account while authorizing the same inner transaction IDs and flags.
records.expected: Batch signer authorization must bind the outer account and sequence as well as inner transaction IDs and flags.
records.source_signal: Later upstream commit 7618b726b; source review of serializeBatch.
records.remediation: Bind BatchSigners signatures to outer account and sequence so replay becomes temBAD_SIGNATURE.

records.title: MPT locked holder unauthorize without SAV
records.affected: rippled 3.1.3 with MPTokensV1 active and SingleAssetVault inactive
markers: MPT current — locked holder can delete lock state without SAV
records.broken: A holder can tfMPTUnauthorize a locked zero-balance MPToken, deleting issuer lock state, then re-authorize without lsfMPTLocked when the SAV gate is inactive.
records.expected: Locked-token deletion checks should not depend on unrelated SAV feature activation.
records.source_signal: Source review of MPTokenAuthorize::preclaim plus upstream no-SAV lock/delete coverage.
records.remediation: Gate locked MPToken deletion on the MPT lock feature itself rather than SingleAssetVault.

records.title: Permissioned-DEX hybrid-offer quality mismatch
markers: Permissioned DEX current — hybrid offer open-book quality mismatch
records.broken: A partially crossed hybrid offer leaves its open-book directory key at one quality while sfExchangeRate records another.
records.expected: Open-book directory key quality and sfExchangeRate metadata must match after partial crossing.
records.remediation: Use the correct open-book placement rate and repair existing bad sfExchangeRate metadata.

records.title: Permissioned-DEX regular-offer cancel invariant failure
markers: Permissioned DEX current — cancel regular offer via domain offer invariant
records.broken: A valid domain OfferCreate that cancels the user regular offer fails with tecINVARIANT_FAILED because the invariant treats the deleted regular offer as forbidden mutation.
records.expected: The invariant should ignore regular offers deleted as part of a valid domain offer cancellation.
records.remediation: Update the permissioned-DEX invariant to ignore deleted regular offers in this path.
